mode: actual policy and signed platform SMS handlers; synthetic memory store; all provider HTTP intercepted; physical networking disabled

checks.name: The exact campaign draft fits the observed form limits and names only the platform sender
Every filed copy field and keyword is identical in the browser script and JSON
The public opt-in proof is a real SMS invitation with a visible prelaunch status
The exact wizard-required legal headings, brand and no-marketing-sharing statement are public
The public terms separate direct replies, restart and shop programs without implied signup consent
The full setup script routes the platform number and service to its own gated published handler
The actual supported shop policy requires written YES after its inbound appointment ask
The supported shop carrier copy and actual public policy describe the same written inbound-SMS permission
The actual legacy policy stays distinct and does not claim v1 consent enforcement
Unknown onboarding versions and missing shops cannot fall into the public legacy policy
The actual public policy escapes tenant text and exposes no permanent owner credentials
The campaign keywords exactly match the real platform receiver
Each campaign sample is a byte-identical response from the actual signed inbound handler
The exact campaign HELP proof and restart/stop acknowledgments match real signed exchanges
The public stop promise holds for another STOP, HELP and ordinary messages until explicit restart
The documented prelaunch gate withholds product and HELP replies without any outbound send
